terra.problem: The verses specify disaster on 'this place,' not Judah as a whole. They say the people built high places on which to burn their children, not explicitly that they had already burned them.
The verses command Jeremiah to shatter the jar; they do not say here that he does so.
The LORD says He will bring every disaster He has pronounced against the city and its surrounding villages, not every disaster without qualification.
